sloka: तच्च दृष्ट्वा धनु: श्रेष्ठं गौरवाद्गिरिसन्निभम् ।अभिवाद्य नृपा जग्मुरशक्तास्तस्य तोलने ॥ २.११८.४३॥
transliteration: tacca dṛṣṭvā dhanu: śreṣṭhaṁ gauravādgirisannibham ।abhivādya nṛpā jagmuraśaktāstasya tolane ॥ 2.118.43॥

translations.english: Beholding the mighty bow resembling a mountain in weight, the kings, unable to lift it, paid their homage and left.
